# DENTE Clinical Dental CRM — LLM Search Index

## Project Summary
DENTE is a high-performance clinical management platform and diagnostic CRM for dental practices.

## Core Capabilities
- Multi-tenant practice management with PostgreSQL row-level isolation.
- Interactive SVG Odontogram supporting FDI and Universal tooth numbering.
- Multi-Planar Reconstruction (MPR) 3D DICOM tomography slice visualizer.
- Kopeck-exact financial accounting and billing ledger.
- Live Web Showcase: https://marko1olo.github.io/dental-crm/

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS Tokens
- Backend: Fastify, Drizzle ORM, Node.js
- Database: PostgreSQL 18
